query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.vencimentoData, CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(15,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) as valor_a_receber FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO') AND ar.vencimentoData <= '2026-05-13T23:59:59' AND (CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(15,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(15,2))) > 0 AND UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) NOT IN ('CLIENTE TESTE REGRA', 'CLIENTE MANUAL TICK TEST', 'CLIENTE LEGACY VIBRATION TEST', 'CLIENTE RECENT VIBRATION TEST', 'CLIENTE TESTE COBRANCA') AND ar.id NOT IN (SELECT ar_id FROM cobranca_planilha WHERE ativo = true AND ar_id IS NOT NULL);
